name: Richard Pryor
note: STAGE PERSONA graph for the 'Why is X Funny?' video series. Graph-only. 0 sets measured — all hypothesis. Public persona only, no biography.

identity.deal: Confessional wildfire: drags his worst nights onstage until the room is crying laughing at a crime scene he's still standing in.
identity.premise: A man who turned his own damage into the most honest stand-up ever recorded, then set fire to the distance between teller and told.
identity.awareness_note: Fully aware; the vulnerability is engineered. He decides how far you come in.

philosophy.ontology: Reality is what happened to you before you could defend yourself.
philosophy.epistemology: Truth only lands if you say the part that shames you.
philosophy.axiology: Honesty over dignity; laughter over healing (but you get both).
philosophy.causality: Named pain stops controlling you; unnamed pain runs you.
philosophy.agency: One comic confessing at full volume can free a room full of liars.

dramatic_core.want: to survive the story by making the room survive it with him
dramatic_core.fear: sanitizing — the clean version is the lie that almost killed him
dramatic_core.need: to be loved for the worst parts, not despite them
dramatic_core.self_model: the guy who ran into the fire and came back with material
blind_spots: the need for the room can outrun the bit

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Treats every personal catastrophe as raw material that only becomes his when he says the unsayable version out loud.
contradictions: the saddest life, the biggest laughs
invented modern stand-up while trying to burn it down

status_model.desired_status: telling the truth better than anyone
status_model.felt_status: survivor who got famous for surviving badly

expression.emotional_restraint: varies by bit — from whisper to explosion
tells: laughing at the part he shouldn't

profile.pace: sprints through scenes, freezes on the confession

problem_space: family as both wound and bit

identity.style_thesis: Confessional-firestorm engine: treats every personal catastrophe as raw material that only becomes his when he says the unsayable version out loud. status_reversal at max: the worst person in the room becomes the most honest. The confession is the moral act even when the content isn't.

timing_profile.doctrine_hypothesis: Sprints through scenes, freezes on the confession. The freeze after the confession is the signature — the room needs the silence to metabolize what he just said. The character voices are the delivery system; the freeze is where the truth lands.

internal.cite: Attardo & Raskin — General Theory of Verbal Humor
internal.claim: Joke = {SO, LM, SI, TA, NS, LA}. Technique and Narrative Strategy shape how the mechanism is staged.

internal.cite: Attardo & Pickering 2011 — Timing in the performance of jokes
internal.claim: Punch lines preceded by substantial pauses (0.6-0.8s+); timing = pause distribution + speech rate.

internal.cite: arxiv 2605.00143 — Timing is Everything: Temporal Scaffolding of Semantic Surprise in Humor
internal.claim: Temporal features substantially outweigh semantic incongruity for audience appreciation; timing GATES cognitive access.
Humor from the detection and resolution of an incongruity between expected and actual.
Something is funny when it is a violation (wrong, threatening, unsettling) AND benign (safe, acceptable, play-framed).

internal.cite: Roger & Duffy / status theory of humor
internal.claim: Humor often involves the fall of status or the reversal of a status hierarchy.
Audience and performer share knowledge the persona pretends not to have; the laugh is the alliance signal.

internal.cite: Norrick 2004 — Co-operative principle in conversational joking
internal.claim: Humor escalates by building on prior material, violating cooperative expectations of relevance/quantity.

essay_seeds.title: Richard Pryor: 'The fire as origin story' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: Tells the story of his own worst night with the cadence of a survival narrative. The room is crying laughing at a crime scene he's still standing in. benign_violation: the violation is extreme; the benign frame is that he survived and is telling it.
outline: what this reveals about the engine

essay_seeds.title: Richard Pryor: 'Characters as escape hatches' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: Becomes a character to say the thing he couldn't say as himself. The character is the benign frame; the content is the violation. The room laughs at the character and absorbs the confession at the same time.
outline: what this reveals about the engine
